walls.street: south front on the Haarlemmerweg, with the entrance at the ground floor

notes: Haarlemmerweg 290-488 (BAG pand 0363100012116511, built 1970, 450 m2 tower footprint, eaves 45.3 m, 14 storeys, 98 flats) is the gallery-flat slab on the south side at Molenwerf. Current appearance (2025): a white/light concrete slab edge and a glass balustrade with thin posts on every storey, a glazed wall with white mullions behind them, and a glazed plinth; the 2022-01-25 west crop and the 2025-07-01/2022-01 south crops agree. The 2019-01-07 east crop and the 2019-11-07 north crop show the building BEFORE the balcony glazing went in: an open in-situ concrete gallery frame with orange-red rails and no glass.

2026-10-21 correction (this lane): the previous draft used `curtain-wall` with the layered kit, which draws the 3DBAG wall itself as the glass skin (likeness: wall not drawn, glazing 1.00 on all four groups, 2,640 tris, no balcony rows). It is now `brick-bay-grid` with `windows: wide`, `wallMaterial: render` and a glass-railed balcony row on storeys 1-13, measured from the 2025 south crop: continuous slab band, glass balustrade, recessed glazed wall with white piers. 18,536 tris under the house's own 40,000 budget (see intent.budgetTriangles).

Bays from measure.ts, per wall: south 10 (2.00 m pitch), east 6, west 11, north 8. South storey 1 is set blank and storey 2 glazed on the crop's own reading (its first two bands measure 0.12 and 0.92 glazing): the lowest band above the plinth is a solid parapet, the next one a fully glazed band.

Likeness 2026-10-21: 4 of 4 groups FAIL, and the reasons are declared, not hidden. walls[0] south: wall colour dL 0.094 (PASS), mean glazing 0.589 vs 0.614 (PASS), columns 10 vs 15 (WARN), IoU 0.489; the remaining failure is one storey band off by 0.25, because the 2022-01-04 crop covers only the lower part of a 45 m wall (61 % usable, top half outside the crop). walls[2] west: dL 0.067, mean 0.574 vs 0.616, columns 11 vs 11, one storey band off by 0.23. walls[1] east and walls[3] north are paired with PRE-RENOVATION 2019 crops (open galleries, glazing 0.42/0.23) while the model draws today's glazed balconies, so their measured comparison cannot pass by construction.

palette.brick = #707576 with wallMaterial render: the measured wall of the 2025 south crop is #595d5d (the recesses and soffits between the white bands dominate the floor-zone cells) and the west crop reads #68635c; #707576 is the measured family with dL +0.09/+0.07. The white slab edges and mullions are the frame/stone slots.
